The following events took place in '''44 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*Coalition between the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] and the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] for a [[mission to the Maw]].<ref name="Allies" />
*[[Trial of Tahiri Veila]].<ref name="Allies" />
*An [[Liberation|uprising]] took place on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]].<ref name="Vortex" />
*[[Blaudu Sextus revolt]].<ref name="Vortex" />
*[[Slavery/Legends|Slavery]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] pushed to the brink.<ref name="Vortex" />
*[[Tendrando Arms Celebrity Sabacc Charity Challenge]].<ref name="Vortex" />
*Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Kenth Hamner]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] made acting [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the New Jedi Order.<ref name="Vortex" />
*[[Funeral of Kenth Hamner]].<ref name="Conviction" />
*[[Natasi Daala]] [[Plan Delta|overthrown]] in a coup led by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Daala was arrested, and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]], and acting Grand Master Sebatyne became leaders of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] as a [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]].<ref name="Conviction" />
*A [[Mission to Klatooine|mission]] was undertaken to negotiate the admission of Klatooine into the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="Conviction" />
*[[Jedi Queen project]].<ref name="Conviction" />
*[[Grunel Ovin]] blew up the ''[[Fireborn]]'' over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Conviction" />
*[[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] [[Destruction of Tahv|destroyed]] by [[Abeloth]]; several [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Abeloth's fleet|defected]] from the Tribe to ally with Abeloth.<ref name="Ascension" />
*Jedi Order withdrawn from Coruscant to hunt down Abeloth.<ref name="Ascension" />
*End of the first Triumvirate.<ref name="Ascension" />
*[[Padnel Ovin]] elected interim [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]].<ref name="Ascension" />
*Abeloth, in the guise of Senator [[Rokari Kem]], elected Chief of State after killing Ovin.<ref name="Ascension" />
*Collapse of the [[Lecersen Conspiracy|Imperial-Alliance conspiracy]], many members killed or abandoned.<ref name="Ascension" />
*The Jedi and [[Club Bwua'tu]] finally defeated the Lost Tribe of Sith and Abeloth.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
*The [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|Lost Tribe War]] ends.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
*[[Imperial Election of 44 ABY]]<ref name="Apocalypse" />
*The [[Wedding of Jagged Fel and Jaina Solo]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />
*Jaina and Jagged Fel's honeymoon at Sakuub.<ref name="Getaway">{{InsiderCite|134|Getaway}}</ref>
